verdict.rationale: WezTerm's shell-integration docs state that it enables jumping through the scrollback to the start of an earlier command, which is the core of this story. The evidence is a single first-party sentence with no detail on the jump mechanism or bindings, no description of the prompt/command marks themselves, and no hands-on or community corroboration. Missing for 10: documented prompt/command-mark (semantic zone) details, the specific jump action or keybinding, setup steps for supported shells, and independent hands-on verification.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump between prompts and command marks in my scrollback thanks to shell integration

citations.quote: jumping through the scrollback to the start of an earlier command, or conveniently selecting the complete output from a command.
